article.title: Brazil Faces a Crucial Choice on Oct. 4
article.author: Democratic Left
article.content: A member of Brazil’s Socialism and Liberty Party (PSOL) discusses their alliance with Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s Workers’ Party (PT) to beat the far right — and the stakes riding on the defeat of Trumpism for Brazil and the rest of the world. The post Brazil Faces a Crucial Choice on Oct. 4 appeared first on Democratic Left .
